name: EPIC 212044397
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 16, 8.8 solar radii and 1.04 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 2,021 parsecs away, 9 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 16, give 1.04 solar masses and 8.8 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,677 K at its surface.
